Armor Enchantment.name: Armor Enchantment
Armor Enchantment.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Inscribed on a piece of armor, the object becomes magical and gives a defensive adjustment of +1 per 5 Class Titles. In addition, it grants one point of Force Armor (as the spell) per Class Title.

Weapon Enchantment.name: Weapon Enchantment
Weapon Enchantment.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Inscribed on a weapon, the object becomes magical and gains +2 to hit and +2 to damage per 5 Class Titles.

Planar Travel.name: Planar Travel
Planar Travel.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Planeshift (takes one minute of focused concentration). Gains minimum powers necessary to survive on that plane without environmental ill effects.

Mobility.name: Mobility
Mobility.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: True Flight (as spell). Jump (as spell). Relocation (as spell, takes one minute of focused concentration to teleport).

Speed.name: Speed
Speed.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Blink (as spell). Grants +10 speed seconds. Grants -1 initiative and -2 defense adjustment per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +1 Agility per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +1 Intelligence per 3 class titles of inscriber.

Health.name: Health
Health.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Grants +1 Vitality per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +5 Endurance per 3 class titles of inscriber. Regeneration: 1d4 Endurance healed per minute; lost limbs may be regrown this way.

Weapons Glyph.name: Weapons Glyph
Weapons Glyph.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Weapon gains +1 magical bonus per 2 class titles of inscriber. Weapon gains +1 extra die of damage per 2 class titles of inscriber.

Final Peace.name: Final Peace
Final Peace.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Engraved within the area of a single necropolis, catacombs, cemetery, or other tomb complex, the glyph will prevent any of the dead buried there from rising as or being raised as undead of any kind; any lingering souls will be sent on to the afterlife. Any undead that enter or are otherwise caught in the area with a level equal to or lower than the class title of the inscriber will be destroyed immediately; undead of higher level than the inscriber of the glyph may enter the area, but may not use any innate powers or abilities.

Fortification.name: Fortification
Fortification.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Engraved on the central keep of a fortress, this glyph doubles the structural strength of all structures of the fortress. Furthermore, any food or water stored inside the fortress will not spoil and are cleared of any contaminants.

Sensuality.name: Sensuality
Sensuality.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Grants +1 Appearance per 3 class titles of inscriber. Grants +1 Charm per 3 class titles of inscriber. Wearer is always clean and presentable and smells faintly of perfume. Glyph is designed to be incorporated as part of another artistic tattoo; viewer must succeed at a Glyph skill roll or a quarter Rune Lore skill roll to recognize the glyph.

Angel`s Glyph.name: Angel`s Glyph
Angel`s Glyph.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: True Flight (as spell). Endure Electricity (as spell). Healing (1d4+1 per titles, as the invocation, once per minute).

Deva`s Glyph.name: Deva`s Glyph
Deva`s Glyph.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Blink (as spell). Endure Cold (as spell). Greater Regeneration (Greater Regeneration: Heals 1d4 points per 10 seconds to all wounded areas including vitals. Cannot regenerate from fire, or acid damage, or if the head is separated from the heart.

Devil`s Glyph.name: Devil`s Glyph
Devil`s Glyph.description: 1) Item sensing: Item distance and direction on same plane. Item condition on any plane. 2) Sense Projection through the item. 3) Returned from anywhere to self for 1/10th WIL. UNIQUE: Teleport (as spell). Endure Fire (as spell). Distortion (as the spell).
